01 / Selected work

One real project, honestly told.

01

Beyond

↗

A class-information website I carried forward as I moved through grades.

HTMLCSSJavaScript

My role

I built most of the site: shaping the structure, styling the pages, and putting the information together in a form classmates could use.

The purpose

Make class information easier to find in one place, then keep the project moving as the class moved into a new grade.

What it taught me

Building for real people means thinking about clarity, not only how the page looks. It also gave me a foundation in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

A live link and project screenshots will be added when they are ready to share.
